decidedOption: show the rolling-week break-fix share as a sub-label on the existing Governance card and flag it above 20%, instead of a new card, section or page

notes.routeMeasurement: /platform/ai/right-now has no row in route-budget-baseline.json, so the rendered sweep has never adjudicated it. Numbers come from rendering WorkforceNowShell with the fixture in apps/web/components/platform/WorkforceNowShell.uxbudget.test.tsx (nine items closed this week, three declared break-fix, so the share reads 33% and the flag is on) and measuring with lib/ux-budget's measureUxBudget plus axe-core. Reading grade measured 2.6. Four more words than the 2026-09-02 measurement of the same shell, all in the one sub-label.
notes.fit: Design 2026-09-02 §4: the share of break-fix among merged work is a Right Now / governance signal; above 20% in a rolling week it is a finding, not a number. The Governance card already carries the two governance gaps (quiet coworkers, coworkers without an owner) as value + sub-label + warning flag; the share joins that sub-label only when at least one item closed in the week, and the card's existing flag turns on above the threshold. No new navigation, form, control, or primary action.
notes.failureState: With nothing closed in the week the sub-label is unchanged, so an empty week reads as an empty week rather than 0% break-fix.
notes.theme: No new styles; the Kpi primitive's existing flag treatment (--dpf-warning) is reused.
